# HAMLO SPORTS — Custom Sports Uniforms & Sportswear

> Factory direct custom team athletic uniforms and dye-sublimated sportswear manufactured in Sialkot, Pakistan. Serving school programs, competitive travel teams, athletic clubs, and professional sports leagues with free 12-hour 3D digital mockups, low minimum orders, and global door-to-door DDP air delivery.

## Core Capabilities & Performance Uniforms

- [Custom Baseball Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-baseball-uniforms/): Full button, two-button, and v-neck sublimated jerseys with tackle twill lettering and game pants.
- [Custom Basketball Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-basketball-uniforms/): Pro mesh reversible uniforms, moisture-wicking interlock jerseys, and warm-up tracksuits.
- [Custom Football Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-football-uniforms/): Heavyweight 280-320 GSM tackle twill football jerseys with spandex side flex panels.
- [Custom Soccer Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-soccer-uniforms/): Aerodyne micro-interlock match jerseys, goalkeeper padded sets, and team training kits.
- [Custom Esports Apparel](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-esports-apparel/): Anti-snag gaming jerseys, pro zip hoodies, and competitive streamer wear.
- [Custom Ice Hockey Sweaters](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-ice-hockey-sweaters/): Pro air-knit sweaters with fight strap tie-downs and heavy reinforced elbows.
- [Custom Lacrosse Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-lacrosse-uniforms/): Reversible mesh pinnies, shooter shirts, and lightweight game shorts.
- [Custom Rugby Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-rugby-uniforms/): Tear-proof ripstop poly-elastane match jerseys with reinforced collars.
- [Custom Softball Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-softball-uniforms/): Fastpitch full-button and two-button moisture-wicking jerseys.
- [Custom Volleyball Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-volleyball-uniforms/): 4-way stretch compression jerseys and athletic court shorts.
- [Custom Wrestling Singlets](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-wrestling-singlets/): Power-flex poly-spandex singlets with silicone gripper leg bands.
- [Custom Flag Football Uniforms](https://hamlosportswear.site/custom-flag-football-uniforms/): Regulation zero-pocket lightweight sublimated match sets.
